hurricane_track_points.name: hurricane_track_points
hurricane_track_points.body_sql:
SELECT
  sid,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  basin,
  season
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  iso_time IS NOT NULL
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  -- Lifted filter: only include rows that represent track observations for tropical cyclones.
  -- Leave exact storm-type/category thresholds to the query caller; here we include rows with a basin (i.e., real tracked storms).
  AND basin IS NOT NULL
hurricane_track_points.description: One row per recorded storm track observation (individual position/time point) for tropical cyclones; include identifiers, timestamp, latitude, longitude, basin, season/year, and any storm id/name. This is a filtered subset representing track observations (not aggregated).

na_2020_hurricane_tracks_raw.name: na_2020_hurricane_tracks_raw
na_2020_hurricane_tracks_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  h.sid AS sid,
  h.name AS name,
  h.season AS season,
  h.number AS number,
  h.iso_time AS iso_time,
  h.latitude AS latitude,
  h.longitude AS longitude,
  h.usa_wind AS usa_wind
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
WHERE
  h.basin = 'NA'
  AND h.season = '2020'
na_2020_hurricane_tracks_raw.description: All track points for storms in the North Atlantic basin for the 2020 season, keeping raw columns needed for ordering, distance computation, and agency wind. Does not compute distances or aggregate by storm.

storm_total_travel_distance_km.name: storm_total_travel_distance_km
storm_total_travel_distance_km.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.sid,
  t.season,
  t.number,
  SUM(ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(prev.longitude, prev.latitude), ST_GEOGPOINT(t.longitude, t.latitude)))/1000.0 AS total_distance_km
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` AS t
JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      sid,
      iso_time,
      latitude,
      longitude,
      season,
      number,
      LAG(iso_time) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_time,
      LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_latitude,
      LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_longitude
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  ) AS seq
  ON t.sid = seq.sid
  AND t.iso_time = seq.iso_time
  -- only keep rows where a previous point exists
  JOIN UNNEST([STRUCT(seq.prev_latitude AS latitude, seq.prev_longitude AS longitude)]) AS prev
WHERE
  seq.prev_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  t.sid,
  t.season,
  t.number
storm_total_travel_distance_km.description: Total travel distance per storm calculated as the sum of geodesic distances between successive cleaned track points (meters converted to kilometers). One row per storm.

storms_shard_rows_normalized.name: storms_shard_rows_normalized
storms_shard_rows_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  event_id,
  event_begin_time,
  -- Normalize state name to 2-letter USPS where possible.
  -- We'll use a CASE mapping for common state names; unknowns become NULL.
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('alabama','ala','al') THEN 'AL'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('alaska','ak') THEN 'AK'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('arizona','az') THEN 'AZ'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('arkansas','ar') THEN 'AR'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('california','ca') THEN 'CA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('colorado','co') THEN 'CO'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('connecticut','ct') THEN 'CT'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('delaware','de') THEN 'DE'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('florida','fl') THEN 'FL'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('georgia','ga') THEN 'GA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('hawaii','hi') THEN 'HI'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('idaho','id') THEN 'ID'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('illinois','ill','il') THEN 'IL'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('indiana','in') THEN 'IN'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('iowa','ia') THEN 'IA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('kansas','ks') THEN 'KS'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('kentucky','ky') THEN 'KY'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('louisiana','la') THEN 'LA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('maine','me') THEN 'ME'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('maryland','md') THEN 'MD'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('massachusetts','mass','ma') THEN 'MA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('michigan','mi') THEN 'MI'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('minnesota','mn') THEN 'MN'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('mississippi','ms') THEN 'MS'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('missouri','mo') THEN 'MO'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('montana','mt') THEN 'MT'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('nebraska','ne') THEN 'NE'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('nevada','nv') THEN 'NV'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('new hampshire','nh') THEN 'NH'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('new jersey','nj') THEN 'NJ'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('new mexico','nm') THEN 'NM'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('new york','ny') THEN 'NY'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('north carolina','nc') THEN 'NC'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('north dakota','nd') THEN 'ND'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('ohio','oh') THEN 'OH'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('oklahoma','ok') THEN 'OK'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('oregon','or') THEN 'OR'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('pennsylvania','pa') THEN 'PA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('rhode island','ri') THEN 'RI'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('south carolina','sc') THEN 'SC'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('south dakota','sd') THEN 'SD'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('tennessee','tn') THEN 'TN'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('texas','tx') THEN 'TX'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('utah','ut') THEN 'UT'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('vermont','vt') THEN 'VT'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('virginia','va') THEN 'VA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('washington','wa') THEN 'WA'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('west virginia','wv') THEN 'WV'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('wisconsin','wi') THEN 'WI'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('wyoming','wy') THEN 'WY'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('district of columbia','dc') THEN 'DC'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('american samoa') THEN 'AS'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('guam') THEN 'GU'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('northern mariana islands','nmi','mp') THEN 'MP'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('puerto rico','pr') THEN 'PR'
    WHEN LOWER(state) IN ('virgin islands','vi') THEN 'VI'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS state_usps,
  -- keep other relevant columns as a single STRUCT to be flexible downstream
  STRUCT(
    episode_id,
    state,
    state_fips_code,
    event_type,
    cz_type,
    cz_fips_code,
    cz_name,
    wfo,
    event_end_time,
    injuries_direct,
    injuries_indirect,
    deaths_direct,
    deaths_indirect,
    damage_property,
    damage_crops,
    source,
    magnitude,
    magnitude_type,
    flood_cause,
    tor_f_scale,
    tor_length,
    tor_width,
    tor_other_wfo,
    location_index,
    event_range,
    event_azimuth,
    reference_location,
    event_latitude,
    event_longitude,
    event_point
  ) AS other_relevant_columns
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
WHERE state IS NOT NULL
  AND event_begin_time IS NOT NULL
storms_shard_rows_normalized.description: Normalize and canonicalize raw storm event rows from all sharded storms_* tables: select relevant columns, filter to rows with non-null state and event_begin_time within the dataset's possible range, and map/normalize state names to 2-letter USPS postal abbreviations where possible. Do not apply date range literals here; keep event_begin_time as-is for later filtering.

gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags.name: gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags
gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  -- canonicalize to DATE using year, mo, da
  DATE(CONCAT(gsod.year, '-', gsod.mo, '-', gsod.da)) AS obs_date,
  -- pass through original numeric temperature fields, treating missing sentinel values as NULL
  NULLIF(gsod.temp, 9999.9) AS temp,
  NULLIF(gsod.max, 9999.9) AS max,
  NULLIF(gsod.min, 9999.9) AS min,
  -- boolean flag: true when temp, max, and min are all non-NULL (after sentinel normalization)
  (NULLIF(gsod.temp, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL
   AND NULLIF(gsod.max, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL
   AND NULLIF(gsod.min, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL) AS is_valid_day_2019
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS gsod
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  gsod.stn = s.usaf
  AND gsod.wban = s.wban
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2019'
gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags.description: Daily GSOD observations for calendar year 2019 normalized to one row per station-day with a boolean flag indicating whether the day has valid temperature, max, and min values (non-NULL). Dates are canonicalized to a date column.

stations_core.name: stations_core
stations_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary station identifier: prefer USAF (usaf) if present, else use wban alone
  COALESCE(NULLIF(s.usaf, ''), s.wban) AS station_id,
  s.name AS name,
  NULL AS wmo_id,
  s.lat AS lat,
  s.lon AS lon,
  CAST(NULLIF(s.elev, '') AS FLOAT64) AS elevation
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
stations_core.description: Canonical row for weather stations with their identifiers and metadata. One row per station identifier keyed by the station's primary id column(s).

daily_observations_raw.name: daily_observations_raw
daily_observations_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- date as DATE type built from year/mo/da strings in GSOD shards
  DATE(PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(mo,2,'0'), '-', LPAD(da,2,'0')))) AS obs_date,
  year AS year,
  CAST(mo AS INT64) AS month,
  CAST(da AS INT64) AS day,
  -- station identifier: prefer concatenated usaf-wban when available (GSOD uses stn/wban)
  CONCAT(stn, '-', wban) AS station_id,
  -- temperature: GSOD 'temp' is in F and uses 9999.9 as missing; keep as-is and map missing->NULL
  NULLIF(NULLIF(temp, 9999.9), CAST('' AS FLOAT64)) AS temperature,
  -- wind speed: GSOD wdsp stored as STRING in schema; convert to FLOAT and treat 999.9 as missing
  -- Use SAFE_CAST to avoid errors; empty strings -> NULL
  (CASE
     WHEN wdsp IN ('', '999.9', '999.90', '999.0') THEN NULL
     ELSE SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)
   END) AS wind_speed,
  -- precipitation: GSOD prcp in inches uses 99.99 as missing
  NULLIF(prcp, 99.99) AS precipitation
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
-- NOTE: lift date-range filtering out of the view; callers should filter with _TABLE_SUFFIX and/or date predicates
-- Also include only real days where year/month/day are present
WHERE
  year IS NOT NULL AND mo IS NOT NULL AND da IS NOT NULL
daily_observations_raw.description: All raw daily (or sub-daily aggregated to day) observation records: timestamp/date, station identifier, temperature, wind speed, and precipitation values as recorded.

station_monthly_observation_cohort.name: station_monthly_observation_cohort
station_monthly_observation_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(station_usaf, '-', station_wban) AS station_id,
  TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'), ' ', LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS STRING),2,'0'), ':', LPAD(CAST(CAST((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 60 AS INT64) AS STRING),2,'0'), ':00')) AS observation_timestamp,
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  CAST(month AS INT64) AS month,
  -- air_temperature: prefer air_temp if available, else use reported air temp field names from ICOADS or GSOD where applicable
  CASE
    WHEN air_temp IS NOT NULL THEN air_temp
    WHEN gsod_temp IS NOT NULL AND gsod_temp NOT IN (9999.9) THEN gsod_temp
    ELSE NULL
  END AS air_temperature,
  -- wetbulb_temperature: use wetbulb if present
  wetbulb AS wetbulb_temperature,
  -- dewpoint_temperature: dew point from datasets (prefer icoads dewpt then gsod dewp)
  CASE
    WHEN icoads_dewpoint IS NOT NULL THEN icoads_dewpoint
    WHEN gsod_dewp IS NOT NULL AND gsod_dewp NOT IN (9999.9) THEN gsod_dewp
    ELSE NULL
  END AS dewpoint_temperature,
  -- sea_surface_temp: use sea_surface_temp if present (ICoads SST fields)
  sst AS sea_surface_temp
FROM (
  -- union observation-level rows from ICOADS (multiple year shards) and GSOD hourly-like rows normalized to observation-level
  -- ICOADS recent shard wildcard (2005-2017)
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS station_usaf,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS station_wban,
    year,
    month,
    day,
    hour,
    -- ICOADS fields mapped
    NULL AS gsod_temp,
    NULL AS gsod_dewp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS air_temp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS wetbulb,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS icoads_dewpoint,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2017'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014

  UNION ALL

  -- older ICOADS shards (1662-2000, limited years but include for completeness)
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS station_usaf,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS station_wban,
    year,
    month,
    day,
    hour,
    NULL AS gsod_temp,
    NULL AS gsod_dewp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS air_temp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS wetbulb,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS icoads_dewpoint,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014

  UNION ALL

  -- GSOD daily shards expanded to per-day observations; GSOD does not have hour in many cases,
  -- but include rows as observation-level using day resolution for observation_timestamp construction.
  SELECT
    stn AS station_usaf,
    wban AS station_wban,
    CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
    CAST(mo AS INT64) AS month,
    CAST(da AS INT64) AS day,
    0.0 AS hour,
    temp AS gsod_temp,
    dewp AS gsod_dewp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS air_temp,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS wetbulb,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS icoads_dewpoint,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2010' AND '2014'
    AND SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
)
-- Keep only rows where all four temperature-related fields are present (as the cohort definition)
WHERE
  year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  AND (
    -- interpret "all four temperature-related fields present" as: air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp all NOT NULL
    -- but these come from mapping above; compute availability via the SELECT aliases using the same logic
    (
      ( (air_temp IS NOT NULL) OR (gsod_temp IS NOT NULL AND gsod_temp NOT IN (9999.9)) )
    )
    AND wetbulb IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (icoads_dewpoint IS NOT NULL) OR (gsod_dewp IS NOT NULL AND gsod_dewp NOT IN (9999.9))
    )
    AND sst IS NOT NULL
  )
station_monthly_observation_cohort.description: Select cleaned hourly (or observation-level) rows for stations with all four temperature-related fields present and with their observation year between 2010 and 2014. This is the base cohort of observations to be aggregated monthly; keep original timestamp, station identifier and separate temperature fields.

monthly_station_averages.name: monthly_station_averages
monthly_station_averages.body_sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(COALESCE(stn, ''), '-', COALESCE(wban, '')) AS station_id,
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  CAST(mo AS INT64) AS month,
  -- GSOD temp is in Fahrenheit to tenths; treat 9999.9 as NULL
  AVG(NULLIF(temp, 9999.9)) AS avg_air_temperature,
  -- GSOD does not provide explicit wetbulb or sea_surface_temp; set to NULL to keep schema.
  NULL AS avg_wetbulb_temperature,
  -- dew point in Fahrenheit to tenths; treat 9999.9 as NULL
  AVG(NULLIF(dewp, 9999.9)) AS avg_dewpoint_temperature,
  NULL AS avg_sea_surface_temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
GROUP BY
  station_id, year, month
monthly_station_averages.description: Compute per-station, per-year-month averages for the four temperature variables from the base observation cohort. One row per station-year-month with the four monthly means.
